P + K

Hello from Pip & Kip

Good things should feel personal.

Love from Pip and Kip began with a simple idea: finding a thoughtful gift should be just as joyful as giving it. We bring together playful, useful and beautifully made pieces that have a little spark of their own.

We’re drawn to brilliant colour, tactile details and the sorts of objects that earn a permanent place on your shelf, desk or bedside table. Every item is selected in small batches, then wrapped with the care we’d give a present for our own favourite people.

This is a growing collection, shaped by curiosity and a genuine love of good design. Pop back often — there’s always another lovely thing around the corner.
